# Adoption Lane Visual Doctrine

## Character

Adoption Lane should feel like a trusted decision instrument rather than a friendly SaaS product.

## Influences

- Swiss typographic rigor
- Industrial HMI restraint
- Transit-map orientation
- Scientific notebook provenance

## Stronger vertical constraints

- Sharp or minimally rounded structural planes
- Fixed route spine and station symbols
- Geometry limited where the method specifies it
- Warm neutral paper surfaces
- Mono labels for IDs, dates, formulas, and provenance
- Tabular numerals
- Semantic state colors only
- Dense, stable, projected readability
- Structural dividers rather than floating cards and shadows

## Relationship to Case Systems

These constraints are an Adoption Lane preset. They do not automatically override the broader Case Systems visual flexibility in other domains.
